basic_profile.bio: Based in Austin, Texas, I am a photography enthusiast with a penchant for capturing urban and natural landscapes. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me the flexibility to travel and explore different photography styles. My interests extend beyond photography; I am a board game aficionado and enjoy sampling world whiskies. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings or late at night. Currently in a relationship, my partner shares my interest in design and photography.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design, which introduced me to the world of visual arts. Over the years, I've honed my photography skills through online courses and self-teaching, and actively participate in photography communities to exchange tips and experiences.
